notes.title: Controller Update
notes.content:
We have changed the input system we were using to a much newer one, this should fix most controller problems that were ocurring, if your controller for some reason is still not functioning properly, please let us know <3.

The issues were mostly messed up buttons and button delays.

We have read a lot of your feedbacks on the demo, we will work on some new things regarding your opinions to make the best game we can! Very soon we will bring in some news!
